title: 4.3 Luna is behind the door
unit_title: Life at home, every day and yesterday
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, talk about the lights and machines, ask what there is, describe someone's morning in order, say what you did yesterday and on which day, ask and tell the time, say how often you do things and give dates.
goal: Say where pets and things are with behind and in front of, next to A1's in, on, under and next to (Luna is behind the door. / Max is in front of the tree.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 4.3 Where Things Are: A1 places things with in, on, under and next to; A1+ 4.3 adds behind and in front of, seen from the camera (Luna is behind the door. / Max is in front of the tree.), asked with 4.1's Where's…?. Sofia's cat Luna and Luis's dog Max (A1+ 1.10) are the pets: in front, the pet is whole and closer to the camera than the door, the sofa or the tree; behind, the door or the tree hides it and only its head and one paw peek out from the edge. Max's two photos are one park photo and its edit. Luna behind a sofa was tried three times and dropped (the edit did not move her; a new photo put her on the seat), so Luna is behind a half-open door instead, with a matching photo in front of the closed door.
prerequisite: A1 4.3 in, on, under, next to; A1 4.2 door, sofa, lamp; A1+ 1.10 Luna and Max; A1+ 4.1 Where's…?.
speaking_outcome: Say in front of as one group (in-FRUN-tuv); stress be-HIND. Do not require native-like speed.
